title: CH86: extra Novig orders
body: Looked at the 7-orders-vs-1-tap question. FAMU Over 55.5: Novig settled exactly the one 284-contract fill, so only one order ever filled; the engine's only order there was a bid on the Under. The extra orders look like unfilled IOC attempts (5x the stake = 5 tries) that Novig lists but the Tracker does not. Not proven: v1.0.78 now logs every attempt, the next report will show it. No path found that places a second filling order.
